Questions

What is the median annual wage for Truck drivers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Heavy and Tractor-Trailer Truck Drivers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $62,300.

What is the hourly median for Truck drivers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Heavy and Tractor-Trailer Truck Drivers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $29.95.

How many Truck drivers work in Chicago?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 62,210 wage-and-salary Heavy and Tractor-Trailer Truck Drivers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Truck drivers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.04. Values above 1.00 mean Heavy and Tractor-Trailer Truck Drivers are more concentrated in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Truck drivers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Heavy and Tractor-Trailer Truck Drivers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $65,170.

How does Chicago's Truck drivers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Chicago's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($62,300) is $5,190 higher than Austin ($57,110) and $8,940 lower than Seattle ($71,240). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
